en.html:
Nothing terrifies like a sudden fire. The alarm immediately woke the neighborhood. People rushed into the street.

And naturally saw it.
The unfinished bridge, nearing completion.
Four men moving around it.
Their tools. Saw, machete, hatchet...
Their faces, stunned at having nowhere to run.

Nothing terrifies like a sudden fire. The alarm immediately woke the neighborhood. People rushed into the street.

And naturally saw it.
The unfinished bridge, nearing completion.
Four men moving around it.
Their tools. Saw, machete, hatchet...
Their faces, stunned at having nowhere to run.

人々は往来へ飛び出した。

　――そして、当然。
　それを目の当たりにする結果となった。

　完成が見えてきた出来かけの橋……
　その周囲に蠢く四人の男。

　彼らの手にある道具。
　鋸、鉈、手斧……。

　逃げ場を失い、呆然とする顔。

en.html:
Unarmed against four experienced gangsters: unfavorable. A tsurugi would be excessive. One sword was appropriate.

Even startled by its sudden appearance in my hand, they gave me no opening. Two advanced, two circled left and right.
Four against one. The proper response would be to create distance and avoid encirclement.

Not this time. Delay might let them turn their blades upon the crowd.
Neither residents nor refugees must be hurt.

So I did not retreat.
I advanced toward the machete on my front right—

　流石と言うべきか、四人は俺の手の中に突如太刀が
現れるのを見て、仰天したとしてもそれで隙を作りは
しなかった。
　二人が前に出て、残り二人は左右に回る。

　四対一の形勢。
　ひとまず距離を取り、囲まれるのを防ぐ――それが
正手であろう。

　しかし今回、時間を掛けるべきではなかった。
　彼らが周囲の人々に刃を向ける事になっては大事だ。

　住民も難民も、絶対に傷付けさせてはならない。

　従って退かぬ。
　前へ出る。

　正面右、鉈を持った男へ――
